title: Be aware
body:
Read the their refund policy before trial. 

Please be aware - important subscription information is buried within a documents most people never read

Most apps downloaded via the App Store offer refunds if requested, even through the Apple subscription system. I assume why my  subscriptions weren't shown under my Apple ID, most apps are more transparent. This makes me think that their business model involves charging a significant amount of money for a monthly fee and burying subscription information in small font within a lengthy document.
author: Samantha Semir

title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE
body:
Do not subscribe to this app it is a scam! No way to cancel subscription. They just took my money. Apple couldn't do anything about it because it wasn't on the subscription page on my Apple ID. 
But please do not download the app and do not subscribe for the free trial. The support team is not contacting.
